## Mathematical Physics

My principal project is **Toroidal Quantum Gravity (Tor.QG)**, a background-independent framework in which quantum spacetime is assembled from interacting noncommutative microscopic geometries. The programme studies the relation between microscopic quantum structure, causal dynamics, and effective gravitation.

<div class="topic-line">Quantum gravity · Noncommutative geometry · Black holes · Cosmology · Foundations</div>

[Explore mathematical physics →](research/mathematical-physics.qmd){.card-link}
:::

::: {.research-panel .ai}
## Artificial Intelligence

My AI research examines anomaly detection and generative modelling through the structure of learned representations. I am especially interested in explicit rule evaluation, semantic anomalies, latent-space geometry, and models that combine neural learning with compositional reasoning.

<div class="topic-line">Anomaly detection · Self-supervised learning · Neuro-symbolic methods · Generative models</div>

[Explore artificial intelligence →](research/artificial-intelligence.qmd){.card-link}
:::
:::

<div class="section-label">Selected Work</div>

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.site-card}
### Toroidal Quantum Gravity: I. Foundations

*Classical and Quantum Gravity* **43**, 145014 (2026). A background-independent quantum-spacetime construction based on noncommutative tori, spectral geometry, discrete causal structure, and covariant gravitational dynamics.

[Journal article →](https://doi.org/10.1088/1361-6382/ae85a6){.card-link}
:::

::: {.site-card}
### Logical Anomaly Detection

A neural evaluator for compositional visual rules, trained with feature-level counterfactual “chimeras” when real rule-violating anomalies are absent.

[Preprint →](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26171){.card-link}
:::

::: {.site-card}
### Phase Structure of High-Dimensional Latents

A statistical-mechanical account of AE/VAE latent spaces using spin-glass observables, with applications to generation and anomaly detection.

[Preprint →](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02600){.card-link}
:::

::: {.site-card}
### Hyperspherical Coordinates for VAEs

A latent-space parameterisation that compresses high-dimensional representations on a hypersphere, improving generative modelling and anomaly detection.

[Publications →](publications.qmd){.card-link}
:::
:::
